method: Whole-file manual reading of traditional Chinese Hong Kong catalog; pinned bytes reverified; v91 structural comparison retained.
findings: 疑似重複檔案 denotes suspected duplicates, 雜湊前綴 explicitly marks prefix and 取樣雜湊 marks sampling; advanced option names sparse hashes above64MiB. Ordinary duplicate caption says same-content files, so probability caption must remain visible for sampled groups.

Recovery completion requests verification of file data, recoverable and possible recovery remain separate, metadata changes request rescan and same-volume restoration warns of overwritten deleted data.
Sparse action 檔案稀疏化 does not conflate conversion with compression, unlike simplified Chinese catalog. Logical size versus actual size labels retain a distinction, though physical is rendered actual.
Reselect-child caption specifies files within a folder, narrower than generic child; select-parent says containing folder of a file, narrower than arbitrary tree item. These are wording limitations.
Cloud warning says scanning will trigger download, stronger than English may-download wording. No hydration-prevention runtime proven. Permanent deletion is not secure-erasure evidence.
Graph algorithms are localized consistently in menu and style list; glob/regex, hardlinks/symlinks/junctions and cleanup tokens remain distinct. MSI zh-HK/3076/950 is declaration-only.
limits: No native-speaker certification, rendered traditional Chinese interface, mnemonic conflicts, installer encoding or Windows runtime validation. No foreign production code adopted.
